prompt: Extract ALL relevant subject-predicate-object candidates from ALL the supplied evidence units using the query predicates, including possible non-answer entities. Return one JSON object {"facts":[{"subject":"name","predicate":"canonical predicate","object":"value","evidence_id":"supplied source ID","quote":"verbatim contiguous substring in that specific source"}]}. Preserve qualifications and uncertainty; do not invent identity links. Each fact must cite its own source, not another unit. Empty list allowed. A literal quote is a locator, not semantic proof. Do not output a final answer table or Markdown fences.
packing: preserve original source ID order; greedy contiguous full units; no truncation, no dropping, no splitting within unit
normalization_join: unchanged original B1 normalized subject-key / read-only SQLite
schema_change: each extracted fact carries evidence_id for per-source literal quote validation
fallback: If predicates exceed reserve or tokenizer/model revision differs, STOP and register engineering amendment before inference; no silent repacking
